name: Steelsnap
summary: Steelsnap is a hunting task issued by Melor Stonehoof on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. The hunt departs from traditional tauren reasons for killing, seeking the destruction of a vicious hyena whose pack terrorizes the wildlife of Thousand Needles.

sections.title: A Hunt Outside the Blessing
sections.body: Tauren tradition dictates that taking a life must serve a sacred or practical purpose: hunting for sustenance, hunting to uphold honor, or hunting to glean wisdom from the Earthmother. Melor Stonehoof offers this quarry as an exception to the rule. Steelsnap is viewed as an abomination against natural balance—a brutal tyrant that sows senseless violence and fear rather than maintaining the cycle of life.

sections.title: The Scourge of the Needles
sections.body: Steelsnap roams the canyons of northern Thousand Needles, lingering south of the centaur enclave at Camp E'thok. Unlike solitary scavengers, this formidable beast draws fierce packmates into his wake, orchestrating attacks that disrupt and cull the more docile wildlife of the canyon floor. Slaying him and retrieving his rib cleanses the needles of his vicious influence.

faq.q: Why does Melor Stonehoof want Steelsnap killed?
faq.answer: Melor Stonehoof considers Steelsnap an aberration that exists outside the Earthmother's blessing. Unlike hunts meant for sustenance, honor, or natural balance, this hunt is an act of cleansing to stop a tyrannical predator from terrorizing peaceful beasts.
Steelsnap prowls the dusty canyon floor of Thousand Needles, south of the centaur settlement at Camp E'thok in the northwestern reach of the zone.

faq.q: What proof must be brought back to Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: You must claim Steelsnap's Rib from the slain beast and present it to Melor Stonehoof atop Hunter Rise.
No. Steelsnap travels accompanied by other hyenas that follow his lead, making confronting him a dangerous multi-target skirmish.

faq.q: How does this hunt differ from traditional tauren hunts?
faq.answer: While the tauren typically hunt solely for sustenance, martial honor, or spiritual insight, this hunt is purely preventative to remove a cruel beast that disrupts the natural harmony of the land.
Melor Stonehoof resides on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff, where he instructs hunters and tests seasoned trackers.

angles.text: For the Shu'halo, taking a beast's life is a spiritual matter. Hunting Steelsnap serves as an instructive lesson in culling elements of the wild that cause senseless cruelty and fall outside the Earthmother's grace.
Taking down Steelsnap tests a tracker's ability to isolate a savage alpha pack leader amidst wandering escorts on the canyon floor.
Carving a safer path through Thousand Needles protects vital supply lines and travelers crossing down from the Barrens toward Shimmering Flats.
